channel.title: AIPM
channel.description: Practical guides, frameworks, and perspectives on AI product management.

item.title: Building a Roadmap When the Technology Changes Every Quarter
item.description: Traditional roadmapping breaks down when your core technology evolves faster than your planning cycles. Here is how to build AI product roadmaps that stay useful.

item.title: Using AI to Scale User Research Without Losing the Signal
item.description: AI can process hundreds of interviews, surface patterns, and generate synthesis. But knowing where to trust it and where to stay hands-on is the skill.

item.title: Discovery Is Different When You Are Building AI Features
item.description: User interviews and jobs-to-be-done still matter. But AI product discovery has a unique additional layer most teams miss entirely.

item.title: Why Most AI Features Fail (And How to Be in the Minority That Succeeds)
item.description: The failure rate for AI feature launches is high. The reasons are almost always the same. Here is the pattern and how to break it.

item.title: What Changes About Leadership When Your Team Builds With AI
item.description: Managing a team that ships AI products requires a different posture than traditional product leadership. The uncertainty is structural, not a sign something is wrong.

item.title: How to Build an LLM Evaluation Framework That Actually Works
item.description: Most teams skip evaluation until something breaks in production. Here is a practical framework for measuring LLM output quality before it costs you.

item.title: The AI PM Tech Stack: What You Actually Need to Know
item.description: You do not need to become an engineer. But knowing which tools your team uses and why will make you a dramatically better AI product manager.

item.title: The Metrics That Actually Tell You If Your AI Feature Is Working
item.description: DAU and retention are not enough. AI features need a measurement framework that captures quality, trust, and the hidden failure modes that standard metrics miss.

item.title: Prompt Engineering Is a Product Skill, Not Just an Engineering One
item.description: PMs who understand prompting make better decisions about what to build, what to promise, and when to ship. Here is the minimum you need to know.

item.title: How to Write an AI Feature Spec That Engineers Actually Want to Build
item.description: Specs for AI features need different ingredients than traditional PRDs. Here is a template that works.

item.title: The Art of the AI Prototype: Testing Before You Build
item.description: The fastest way to validate an AI product idea is not to build it. Here are the prototyping techniques that compress months of development into days of learning.

item.title: Communicating AI Uncertainty to Stakeholders Without Losing Their Confidence
item.description: Uncertainty is built into AI products. How you talk about it to executives, customers, and your team determines whether they trust you or not.
